title: When you need company that changes you
issueStatement: You are trying to sustain a spiritual life in isolation, or staying near company that intensifies noise instead of remembrance.
centralInsight: Sangat in Gurbani is not generic belonging. It is relational placement that redirects the mind toward Naam, humility, and steadiness.
practicalReflection: Not every circle can cool the body. Some company makes the fire bigger. Guru tells you to notice the difference.
actionPrompt: Move one step closer to living company that makes remembrance easier.

source.shortMeaning: Human life is the chance, and saint company is part of how that chance is used well.
source.lifeApplication: Do not separate purpose from the company that trains it.

excerpts.explanation: This keeps sangat tied to the actual work of life.

source.shortMeaning: Sat Sangat is not accessory; it changes what becomes possible in the crossing.
source.lifeApplication: Right company can alter the whole emotional forecast.

excerpts.explanation: These lines make company practical, not merely idealistic.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy places the seeker near the saint, and the whole body cools.
source.lifeApplication: Some relief comes not from explanation, but from placement.

excerpts.explanation: Sangat is presented as gift and remedy together.
